### Summary of Parsing:
1. **Log Parsing & Filtering**: Read `workspace/app.log`, parsing entries using `<timestamp> [<LEVEL>] <service>: <message>`. Filtered entries to retain only `ERROR` and `CRITICAL` levels (case-insensitive).

   - `message`: Extracted the text following `<service>: ` on the first line of the log entry.
   - `exception`: Extracted the last line of the traceback attached to the entry (if present), or `null` otherwise.
   - `repeat_count`: Computed as `1 + N` for any `-- last message repeated N times --` lines following the entry and its extra lines.
   - `counts_by_service`: Summed the `repeat_count` values grouped by each service.
